text_block_list.text: After the Arima Kinen race—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It has come to an end, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian, why did you let it slip away?! You 
should have taken 1st place, shouldn't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're seriously strong! That's why I'm 
definitely not gonna lose next time...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And that's why, all this time, I've been 
giving it everything I've got...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama-san.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Why the hell did you lose...! You were 
supposed to stay forever out of reach...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't cry!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledge my result. And accept yours as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't think this is the end, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I will keep challenging myself. Just like 
the Umamusume I've competed against in the 
Classics."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Just like you, who always stood back up 
even after being broken once."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Do not underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: Was it really okay to say it like that?
Was it really okay to say it like that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the message got through to her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I'm a far more tenacious Umamusume than 
the idealized version of me, you see."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll become so fast and strong 
that I'll leave the me of today in the 
dust.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so there's no time to rest our 
wings.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, this year has been eventful. 
Challenging the Classic Triple Crown, 
learning the strength of others, training 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that final victory slipped right 
through my fingers.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. The Twinkle Series never 
leaves any room for boredom.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I shall train even harder. With 
the resolve to crawl back up from the 
depths of hell.
choice_data_list:
What are you going to do for your target 
race after the new year?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You decide.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Take me somewhere I can grow stronger. Via 
the shortest path possible.

Next year is the Senior year. To grow 
stronger, it would be best to gain 
experience by racing against the elite.

"In that case, we'd like to see how things 
go around the prestigious spring shield, 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)... or its stepping 
stone, the Hanshin Daishoten."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let me run even more.
